title: Laisse-le faire !
intro: After verbs of the senses (**voir, regarder, entendre, écouter, sentir**) and after **laisser** (to let), French simply adds an infinitive: *j'entends Enzo **chanter*** (I can hear Enzo singing), *elle le laisse **travailler*** (she lets him work). There's no *de* or *à*, and object pronouns go before the first verb: *je **l'**entends chanter*.

cases.label: voir, regarder + infinitive
cases.rule: After **voir** and **regarder**, an infinitive shows the action you see: *Je **vois** Enzo **arriver**. Ils **regardent** Enzo **travailler**.* English often uses *-ing*: *I can see Enzo coming.*

cases.label: entendre, écouter + infinitive
cases.rule: After **entendre** and **écouter**: *J'**entends** Enzo **chanter**. On **écoute** Tom **jouer**.* The person can also come after the infinitive: *J'entends chanter Enzo.*

cases.label: sentir + infinitive
cases.rule: **Sentir** works the same way, for smells and feelings: *Je **sens** le pain **cuire**. Il **sent** son cœur **battre**.*

cases.label: laisser + infinitive: to let
cases.rule: **Laisser** + infinitive means *to let someone do something*: *Elle **laisse** Enzo **travailler** seul. **Laisse-moi faire** !* No *de*, no *à*.

cases.label: pronouns before the first verb
cases.rule: Object pronouns go before **voir, entendre, laisser**: *Je **l'**entends chanter. Ne **le** laisse pas partir ! On **les** voit sourire.* In a positive order, after: *Laissez-**le** dormir !*

examples.fr: Par la fenêtre, {je vois la pluie tomber|lv-voir}.
examples.en: Through the window, I can see the rain falling.

sections.title: 4. laisser: to let

examples.fr: {Madame Fournier laisse Enzo faire les croissants|lv-laisser}.
examples.en: Mme Fournier lets Enzo make the croissants.

sections.tip: Careful: *laisser* + a noun alone means *to leave*: *Je laisse mon sac ici.*

examples.en: I hear him singing every morning.
Let him do it: he's learning!

mistakes.why: After **entendre**, the second verb is an infinitive.
No **de** after *laisser*: the infinitive follows directly.
Enzo is the one singing: use **le** (l'), not *lui*.

story.title: Le premier matin d'Enzo
story.en: Saturday 28 November, four in the morning: for the first time, Mme Fournier lets Enzo make the croissants on his own.

lines.fr: Le samedi vingt-huit novembre, à quatre heures du matin, Madame Fournier fait une chose nouvelle : {elle laisse Enzo préparer les croissants|lv-laisser} tout seul.
lines.en: On Saturday 28 November, at four in the morning, Mme Fournier does something new: she lets Enzo make the croissants on his own.

lines.fr: Moi, je fais le pain à côté. Les croissants, c'est pour toi. {Je te laisse faire|lv-pronom}.
lines.en: I'm making the bread next door. The croissants are yours. I'll let you get on with it.

lines.fr: Cimer, Mamie… euh, merci ! Tu vas voir : ils seront parfaits.
lines.en: Ta, Grandma… er, thank you! You'll see: they'll be perfect.

lines.fr: Au troisième étage, Tom se réveille. {Il entend quelqu'un chanter|lv-entendre} en bas.
lines.en: On the third floor, Tom wakes up. He can hear someone singing downstairs.

lines.fr: Sur le palier, il trouve Hugo, en pyjama, devant sa porte.
lines.en: On the landing, he finds Hugo in his pyjamas, outside his door.

lines.fr: {Toi aussi, tu l'entends chanter|lv-pronom} ? Je jouais en ligne avec la fibre… Et maintenant, {je sens les croissants cuire|lv-sentir} !
lines.en: You can hear him singing too? I was playing online with the fibre… And now I can smell the croissants baking!

lines.fr: Ça sent bon… mais ça sent aussi le brûlé, non ?
lines.en: It smells good… but it smells burnt too, doesn't it?

lines.fr: Ils descendent. Par la vitrine de la boulangerie, {ils voient Enzo courir|lv-voir} entre le four et le comptoir.
lines.en: They go down. Through the bakery window, they see Enzo running between the oven and the counter.

lines.fr: Ma première plaque ! Elle est toute noire ! Mamie va me tuer…
lines.en: My first tray! It's all black! Grandma's going to kill me…

lines.fr: Mais non. {Je t'ai regardé travailler|lv-voir} : tu as tout fait comme il faut. Le four est juste trop chaud.
lines.en: Of course not. I watched you working: you did everything right. The oven's just too hot.
Let me turn the oven down, and start again.

lines.fr: Tom et Hugo restent devant la vitrine. {Ils regardent Enzo travailler|lv-voir}, comme un vrai boulanger.
lines.en: Tom and Hugo stay at the window. They watch Enzo working, like a real baker.

lines.fr: À six heures, {on entend le four sonner|lv-entendre}. Enzo sort la deuxième plaque : des croissants dorés, parfaits.
lines.en: At six, they hear the oven ring. Enzo takes out the second tray: golden croissants, perfect ones.

lines.fr: Venez goûter ! C'est moi qui invite.
lines.en: Come and try them! They're on me.

lines.fr: Miam ! {Je sens le beurre fondre|lv-sentir} dans ma bouche. C'est chanmé !
lines.en: Yum! I can feel the butter melting in my mouth. It's wicked!

lines.fr: Bravo, Enzo ! La semaine prochaine, {je te laisse faire le pain|lv-pronom} aussi.
lines.en: Well done, Enzo! Next week, I'll let you make the bread too.

lines.fr: Le pain ? À quatre heures du matin ? Tout seul ?
lines.en: The bread? At four in the morning? On my own?

lines.fr: Madame Fournier, {laissez-le dormir|lv-pronom} un peu, d'abord !
lines.en: Mme Fournier, let him get a bit of sleep first!

lines.fr: À sept heures, les premiers clients arrivent. {On les voit sourire|lv-pronom} quand ils goûtent les croissants d'Enzo.
lines.en: At seven, the first customers arrive. You can see them smile as they taste Enzo's croissants.

quiz.q: Par la vitrine, ils voient Enzo ___ entre le four et le comptoir.
quiz.en: Through the window, they see Enzo running between the oven and the counter.
I can hear someone singing downstairs.

quiz.q: « J'entends chanter Enzo » means the same as…

quiz.en: I can smell the croissants baking!

quiz.q: « Il sent son cœur battre » means…
options: He can feel his heart beating.
quiz.answer: He can feel his heart beating.

quiz.q: « Elle laisse Enzo travailler seul » means…
Enzo chante ? Oui, je ___ entends chanter.
quiz.en: Is Enzo singing? Yes, I can hear him singing.
